entry.title: Los Angeles Dodgers staff and front office: New Dodgers hitting coach Pedro Guerrero spoke to The Athletic about his hire and fit alongside Robert Van Scoyoc. Some of what he hopes to bring, free and unlocked: www.nytimes.com/athletic/777...
Baltimore Orioles offseason notes: Boras thinks Orioles will continue to be aggressive in pursuing free agents #Orioles
Labor and the CBA: Boras' main point was that players are "emboldened" to resist a salary cap, given the record-setting team valuations and the game's success in recent years.
Cincinnati Reds staff and front office: The #Reds have hired former Astros and Tigers coach Anthony Iapoce to be their new assistant hitting coach.

Boston Red Sox staff and front office: The worst-kept secret at the GM Meetings is that the Red Sox are shopping Jaren Duran (a year too late, but nonetheless). Sox have also inquired about free agent Seiya Suzuki to add to a lineup that finished 12th in the AL in home runs last season
Jacob Young: Jacob Young’s 4-year extension is now official. The Nationals are planning a Monday press conference for him.
Tarik Skubal: The Padres are expected to meet with Tarik Skubal. How serious are the team’s new owners? Analysis with @dennistlin: www.nytimes.com/athletic/777...

Darwinzon Hernández: Darwinzon Hernández, a lefty reliever for the Red Sox from 2019-22, pitched for the past 4 seasons for the Fukuoka Softbank Hawks and is negotiating to return to MLB. The Mets are among the teams that have checked in. Last year: 1.41 ERA/55 Ks in 44.2IP

Brooks Raley: Mets have checked in with Brooks Raley, according to a person familiar with the situation. Other teams interested, but makes sense to explore for New York given they need to rebuild and his success there.

Sal Stewart: Sal Stewart's ROY victory came as zero surprise to anyone with their eye on the tea leaves. JJ Wetherholt's slip back to third, however, was another glimpse into a problem the Cardinals need to mind -- chosen irrelevance, and how they get out: words-about-birds.beehiiv.com/p/in-wetherh...

Houston Astros staff and front office: The Astros hired Brad Ausmus as their manager on Wednesday, reuniting the franchise with a familiar face while reigniting questions about the hierarchy of authority within its baseball operations department - www.nytimes.com/athletic/777...
New York Mets offseason notes: Offseason blueprints can be complicated. It shouldn’t be for the Mets. The best available player fits your most acute need. Sign him.

Emilio Pagán: Tigers in agreement on 1-year contract with veteran closer Emilio Pagán, per source, as @jonheyman.bsky.social first reported. Deal still pending physical. News comes hours after Scott Harris discussed focus on adding swing-and-miss RH veteran relief help. www.mlb.com/tigers/news/...

The trade market: From the GM Meetings, some notes on #BlueJays potential infield trade options, a big bullpen move (?), Atkins on Anthony Santander and more. (For the record, I did not pick the photo): www.nytimes.com/athletic/777...

Daniel Duarte: A minor but useful note: While some websites list Daniel Duarte as being out of minor-league options in 2027, he does have one remaining. That helps the Mets' flexibility in their pen next season.
Trevor Rogers: Orioles maintain interest in Trevor Rogers: ‘We’d like to retain him.’ #Orioles

Buster Posey: Buster Posey met with media at GM meetings and said he doubted the Giants will sign any free agents with qualifying offers. Reading between the lines, they are looking at next year as a build-up season.

San Francisco Giants staff and front office: The Giants are promoting quality control coach Taira Uematsu to first base coach. He’s the first Japanese born and raised base coach in MLB history. Shane Robinson will move to a minor league role for family reasons.

Around the market: #BlueJays GM Ross Atkins on Anthony Santander’s posts last week: “There aren't words to express my level of disappointment with him making those comments. I've expressed that to him. I think anything exasperating, some level of hate, anti-Islamic, is just extremely concerning.”
Free agency: Brian Cashman described hitting coach James Rowson as “a free agent” and would not say what the hitting coach group would look like.
New York Yankees offseason notes: nypost.com/2026/11/10/s... Key questions at the heart of Yankees’ decision making this offseason.

Milwaukee Brewers staff and front office: PECOTA projected wins --> actual wins ATL: 92.2 --> 94 PHI: 85.1 --> 88 MIL: 80.5 --> 103 Making a case for each of this year's Manager of the Year Award finalists: www.mlb.com/brewers/news...

Washington Nationals: bullpen: Everyone knows the Nationals need significant bullpen help, but what’s the best way to do that? Go all-in on one of the few proven available closers? Sign multiple (more affordable) veteran setup men? A look at some of their options: natsjournal.com/p/whats-the-...
Los Angeles Angels staff and front office: The Angels are finally going to start talking to some GM candidates here in Vegas. We don't know who any of them are yet. www.ocregister.com/2026/11/09/a...

JoJo Romero: DG reporting this morning that the Cardinals have an interest in a reunion with JoJo Romero. Source this afternoon told me that interest is definitely mutual. We’ll see if that’s enough to get a deal done.
Christian Cairo: The Dodgers have claimed Christian Cairo off waivers, the Mets announce
Corey Seager: Column: Yankees should trade for Corey Seager and solve two issues nypost.com/2026/11/08/s...
Antoine Kelly: The Guardians signed lefty Antoine Kelly to a Minor League deal with an invite to Spring Training.
Philadelphia Phillies offseason notes: We also debate what’s most important for the Phillies this offseason: a legit right-handed bat or a lockdown set up guy?￼
Seattle Mariners staff and front office: Mariners involved a select number of players in managerial search. Story, unlocked and free to read: www.nytimes.com/athletic/776...
Jyun Yue Tseng: RHP Jyun-Yue Tseng of the CPBL’s Fubon Guardians is now available through the MLB posting system. His negotiation start date will be Nov 8th at 8:00 a.m. (ET).

Maddox Long: Good story from colleague Jesse Borek on Maddox Long, a big (6-5, 275) RHP who made a big impression in AFL after signing with Tigers out of Indy ball back in June. www.mlb.com/news/tigers-...
Milwaukee Brewers offseason notes: Free agents Arbitration eligibles 40-man adds After a fun October, the offseason is here. Catch up on the Brewers’ to-do list: www.mlb.com/news/brewers...

St. Louis Cardinals offseason notes: One piece of news Bloom announced today: Linda Brauer, the senior executive assistant to the president of baseball ops, was named the Cardinals' winner of the Katy Feeney Leadership Award, handed out every year to a woman from every organization.

St. Louis Cardinals staff and front office: Not much on the news front from the Cardinals presser outside of the reason to call it. No announcement yet on the coaching staff (and it will still be perhaps a week), no immediate internal promotions to announce to backfill.
José Tena: The Guardians have claimed José Tena off waivers from the Nationals. Cleveland dealt him to Washington in the 2024 Lane Thomas trade.

Reiver Sanmartin: Nationals have acquired LHP Reiver Sanmartin from the Giants for RHP Robert Cranz. Sanmartin, 30, had 4.22 ERA, 1.359 WHIP in 24 games this season, was DFA'd earlier this week. Cranz, 7th round pick in '24, had strong year with Wilmington and Harrisburg, struggled at Rochester.
Cincinnati Reds offseason notes: Jim Day and I talked with #reds manager Terry Francona on Hot Stove League this week. Here is some of what Francona had to say. www.mlb.com/news/terry-f...

Detroit Tigers staff and front office: Tigers finalize their coaching staff, formally announcing Kyle Hudson and Martin Maldonado as coaches. Catching coach Ryan Sienko will also serve as bullpen coach, filling an opening left when assistant pitching coach Juan Nieves was not retained.
Boston Red Sox offseason notes: With GM Meetings set for next week, digging into some free agents the Red Sox might target www.nytimes.com/athletic/775...
New York Mets staff and front office: Sources: The Mets are hiring Johnny Washington as a co-hitting coach. He had been the Braves minor league hitting coordinator.

Seiya Suzuki: Let's play matchmaker. Seiya Suzuki is going to be the main character of the #BlueJays' offseason, and on paper, he's the most obvious match we've seen since George Springer: www.mlb.com/bluejays/new...
Tristan Beck: Tristan Beck, who was placed on unconditional release waivers earlier this week, has agreed to a deal to play for the LG Twins of the KBO, a source told MLB dot com.
Cleveland Guardians staff and front office: Guardians assistant pitching coach Joe Torres has been named the lead pitching coach for Terry Francona's Reds.

Washington Nationals offseason notes: Paul Toboni published a long letter to Nationals fans in which he discussed last season, the offseason and objectives for 2027. No earth-shattering news, but this was perhaps the most-notable section:

Washington Nationals: payroll and ownership: The Nationals enter the offseason with by far the fewest dollars committed to their 2027 roster than any team in baseball. There’s money to be spent on upgrades, even if they don’t exceed their 2026 payroll in the end. natsjournal.com/p/nats-have-...
Free agent rankings: One of the biggest days of the year: TOP 50 FREE AGENTS W/PROJECTED CONTRACTS It's a top-heavy class but with plenty of intrigue and rumors: www.espn.com/mlb/story/_/...

Myles Straw: More on the #BlueJays' decision to decline Myles Straw's 2027 club option as the offseason gets underway... www.mlb.com/bluejays/new...
